messages:
Maya: Quick sync — Nimbus + TensorWave + OrbitOps are ready to greenlight the aurora-east-2 region. Requested items: quota (200 vGPU), marketplace SKU entitlements, KMS key, and legal sign-off. Target launch: 2026-04-28. Who owns each item?
Rob: I can own infra quotas and marketplace QA. Need exact SKU IDs from Nimbus.
Nimbus-Biz: Nimbus can provision quotas. SKU list attached: `NIM-AUR-8A-200`, `NIM-AUR-KMS-1`. Will need estimate of steady-state RPS.
Li: For Dedicated pools we need a capacity plan. Can you share expected qps and seq len distribution? Also prepare billing test accounts.
Sofia_PS: I'll handle partner enablement and add OrbitOps to the onboarding playbook. When's the press window?
Maya: Press embargo window we discussed is two weeks after launch, but joint announcement depends on legal.
Ana_Legal: I'll review the marketplace T&Cs and the joint press template by EOD tomorrow. Need data sharing matrix and KMS SLA.
TensorWave-Ops: We'll ship 200 x TWave-A100-equivalent nodes. KMS integration tested in staging; need IP allowlist from Redwood.
OrbitOps-SI: We'll provide SI runbook and install automation. Can we get access to a staging tenant by next Tue?
Rob: Staging tenant request noted. @TensorWave-Ops please DM infra CIDR for allowlist.
press-bot: Note: press embargo date placeholder set to 2026-05-12 in calendar.
Maya: Two blockers: legal sign-off and marketplace entitlement approval. If legal delays, fallback plan is soft launch via Dedicated only.
Li: Also flag: egress pricing in that region differs — need final cost delta to share with sales. @Nimbus-Biz can you confirm?
Nimbus-Biz: Egress delta ~ +4% vs eu-west; will confirm exact numbers by tomorrow.
Rob: SDKs/region routing needs a model tag: `aurora-east-2-v1`. We'll add routing rule in next deploy. snippet:
```
route {
  region: "aurora-east-2"
  fallback: "eu-west-1"
}
```
Sofia_PS: I'll schedule a partner dry run on 2026-04-20 for onboarding and billing tests.
Maya: Action items: (1) @Ana_Legal review T&Cs, (2) @Nimbus-Biz confirm quotas + egress, (3) @TensorWave-Ops send CIDR, (4) @Li create staging tenant, (5) @Sofia_PS run onboarding. Update this thread with status.
TensorWave-Ops: CIDR sent via DM to Rob.
Ana_Legal: Uploaded redlined press template to /legal/partners/aurora-east-2. Ping me with questions.
OrbitOps-SI: Staging access request approved. Send service account email.
Rob: Created staging tenant `aurora-e2-staging`; service account created: `orbitops-staging@redwood-inference-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com`
Maya: Thanks all — will reconvene Fri 09:30 for final go/no-go. :thumbsup:
